hook_launcher_error: generated hook wiring calls {{relative}}, which is missing or not executable — every akmon hook command fails silently (an unavailable executable produces no session-visible error), so the guardrails are off
hook_launcher_error_fix: Install the akmon dev pin into a project-local virtualenv, then re-run akmon sync.
python_refuses_ecosystem: akmon verify: this project's integration record names ecosystem = "{{value}}" (<AITNA_ROOT>/.akmon.toml), and the Python implementation serves Python projects only; run the JavaScript implementation for it: npx akmon verify
changelog_package_mode: package mode: changelog discipline is owned by the akmon repository
changelog_package_mode_fix: Track the standard's changelog discipline in the akmon repository itself.
vendored_leftover: {{path}} is no longer shipped by the akmon carrier; `akmon init --mode vendored` copies only the standard's members and leaves it in place
vendored_leftover_fix: Remove {{path}} by hand if the mount should match the carrier.
unsupported_record: akmon verify: the JavaScript implementation serves Node package mode only (mount = "package" and ecosystem = "node" in <AITNA_ROOT>/.akmon.toml), but this project has {{found}}; run the Python implementation of akmon for it.

node.launcher_pnp: Yarn Plug'n'Play is in use ({{found}} is present) and installs no node_modules — the generated hook wiring runs node on node_modules/akmon/js/hooks, so every akmon hook command fails silently (an unavailable script produces no session-visible error) and the guardrails are off
node.launcher_pnp_fix: Set nodeLinker: node-modules in .yarnrc.yml and reinstall the dependencies, then re-run akmon sync.
node.launcher_hoisted: generated hook wiring runs node on {{relative}}, which is missing, but akmon is installed at {{found}} — neither the committed wiring nor the generated pointers can reach it, so every akmon hook command fails silently and the guardrails are off
node.launcher_hoisted_fix: Install akmon in this package's own devDependencies so it is linked into its own node_modules, then re-run akmon sync.
node.launcher_missing: generated hook wiring runs node on {{relative}}, which is missing — every akmon hook command fails silently (an unavailable script produces no session-visible error), so the guardrails are off
node.launcher_missing_fix: Install the project's dependencies so node_modules/akmon exists, then re-run akmon sync.
node.launcher_ok: generated hook wiring runs node on {{relative}}, which is present
node.launcher_ok_fix: Keep akmon installed in the project's own node_modules.
node.pin_runtime: package.json pins akmon as a runtime dependency (dependencies, optionalDependencies or peerDependencies); it is dev tooling and belongs in devDependencies
node.pin_runtime_fix: Move the akmon requirement into devDependencies.
node.pin_unreadable: package mode: package.json is not a valid JSON object — no akmon pin can be read from it, and npm cannot resolve `akmon` from it either
node.pin_unreadable_fix: Fix the JSON syntax in package.json; akmon stays pinned in devDependencies.
node.pin_none: package mode: package.json does not pin akmon in devDependencies — `akmon` cannot resolve here, so the CI checks above cannot run
node.pin_none_fix: Pin akmon in devDependencies with `npm install -D -E akmon`.
node.exact_pin_warn: package.json pins akmon as {{value}}, not an exact version — two installs can resolve different akmon versions while the record and the generated wiring are written per version
node.exact_pin_warn_fix: Pin an exact version with `npm install -D -E akmon@<version>`, or a release tag with `npm install -D github:akumidv/ai_akmon#v<version>`.
